artifact_review: The Router identified texture smudging on the chest and structural collapse at the rear paw. I agree with these findings. The rear paw grounding issue noted by the Router is accurate; the toes blend into the grass blades. The chest fur texture anomaly is also valid—the transition from white fur to the red patch lacks crisp strand definition in spots. These artifacts warrant a moderate penalty.
